_: The shape of work/<client>/brand.json, as a machine-readable copy of the schema in
.cursor/agents/airship-brand-research.md. The agent file is written for a reader; this
one is what check_brand.py enforces. If they ever disagree, the agent file is the
source of truth for wording and this file is the source of truth for structure.
The shape is FLAT and the key names are not free. goal_candidates.resolve_context()
reads name, vertical, business_model, description, markets, conversion_meaning, notes,
sources, not_applicable_archetypes and not_applicable_attributes directly off this
object. Nesting them, or renaming one, breaks mode B silently: the engine falls back to
the tagging-plan inference and nothing reports that it did. A draft of this schema
grouped the same facts into sixteen nested blocks and would have done exactly that.
The caps are not style. They are what the report renders: a fifth priority is written
and then dropped by the §3c card grid, and a 60-word business_model is truncated by the
§1 layout. Writing past a cap is cost with no reader.

budget._: Hard stops. Wave 0 gates nothing, so it must never become the long pole.

region._: only when country is genuinely unclear

app_name._: App Store / Play name, or Android package id

app_store_country._: store code for the icon fetch

seasonality._: commercial moment + when; a moment inside the window changes how the whole calendar reads

news._: YYYY-MM — event; last 12 months only, an older item cannot explain a spike in the window

notes._: anything the sections must not get wrong

not_found._: '<field>: <where you looked>' — a blank is information, a silent omission is not

not_applicable_archetypes._: vertical archetypes this business cannot have; no script can infer these
